title: Portrait of DCI John A. McCone
description: Dark black-and-white portrait photograph of a bespectacled man, captioned "DCI John A. McCone." It accompanies Chapter 5 text (page 201) on the discovery of SA-2 SAM sites in Cuba in 1962, McCone's suspicions about medium-range ballistic missiles, and the 10 September 1962 meeting on U-2 vulnerability.
